about_the_game:
Overview

Battle it out in this classic Real Time Strategy experience to defeat your opponents and establish a foothold on new worlds! Set in the future, space travel is commonplace and new technology affords for the discovery and settlement of nearby planets. Lawlessness abounds on these novel horizons as multistellar corporations compete to achieve dominance. Join in the fight and command your forces to victory!

Combat

Battles consist of three distinct unit types. Whether it be the nimble hovercrafts, powerful land vehicles, or fast moving aircraft, all three take special considerations to utilize their full potential.

Economy

Manage your economy through an intuitive production chain. Gather raw resources to process into materials, then upgrade to advanced alloys and unlock the strongest units and technologies. While you can produce everything you need in-base, the most efficient production comes from natural resources spread across the map.

Customizable Unit Rosters

Tailor your unit rosters to your own playstyle via the unit loadout system. Each company offers their own unique roster of units to choose from, with the freedom to choose the model characteristics best suited to your playstyle and unit composition. Take care, though! It will be up to you to balance your forces and manage any threat that the opponent may offer.

System Conquest

Astro Industry Wars will feature a strategy map experience. Stay tuned for more details!
